# Rwanda

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.49, by age as below | DHS 2025, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.39 | DHS 2025, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | −0.56 (95% prediction interval −1.25 to 0.13) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) at GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2021 international $) of $3,559 (2025, World Bank) |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |

Divide each value by 100 × (1 − p) before passing it to OG-Core ([how](../calibration-guide.md#converting-a-gradient-to-og-cores-units)).

## Notes

- The 2002 census includes a household-deaths module but is not published: its asset data separate only two wealth groups, fewer than the three required for a gradient. Adult mortality therefore uses the general gradient.
